Tessa / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier — excited about the possibility of listing Redwood in the CloudValet marketplace and having Apex Systems as a GSI connector. Quick recap from our side:

- Use case: APAC & NA customers needing predictable inference for regulated workloads (Private + Dedicated).
- Key buyer: Apex's Platform Ops + CloudValet marketplace procurement.
- Risks/asks: SOC2 evidence, marketplace listing timeframes, and a short technical pairing to validate deployment options.

Can we lock a partner-led demo/technical deep dive next week? Our suggested slots (PT):
- Tue Apr 16 10:00–11:00
- Wed Apr 17 08:30–09:30
- Thu Apr 18 14:00–15:00

I've attached a one-page mutual action plan and our intake form (CloudValet_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx). If Apex needs to join, please loop them in — Rachel O'Neal is our GSI contact and I can add her once you confirm.

Thanks,

Sanjay Patel
